summary: A freelancing app with two modes: one for customers (clients) and one for freelancers.
architectural_notes: Two distinct user roles: Customer and Freelancer, each with their own dashboard and feature set.
known_issues: Role selection persists incorrectly when user tries to continue as a different customer or freelancer role — previously chosen role is shown instead of allowing fresh selection.

existing_features.title: Implement a role selection onboarding screen where users choose to sign up as a Customer (client) or a Freelancer before accessing the app. Store the selected role and associate it with the user's identity.

Implement the Customer mode: allow customers to post job listings with a title, description, budget, and category; browse and manage their posted jobs; view freelancer proposals on each job; and hire a freelancer by accepting a proposal.

Implement the Freelancer mode: allow freelancers to browse all open job listings, filter by category, submit proposals (with a cover letter and proposed price), and manage their active and completed work.
Implement a freelancer profile that includes a display name, bio, skills list, and hourly rate. Customers should be able to view a freelancer's profile when reviewing proposals.

Design and apply a cohesive visual theme across the entire app. Use a clean, professional aesthetic suited for a freelancing marketplace — warm neutrals with amber/teal accents, strong typographic hierarchy, card-based layouts for job listings, and clear role-differentiated dashboard styles.

Fix the RoleSelectionPage so that it does not pre-populate or lock in a previously chosen role. When an authenticated user reaches the role selection screen, they must be presented with a fresh, unselected choice between Customer and Freelancer, and the previously stored role must not influence or pre-select the UI state.

new_feature_requests.summary: Customer mode: browse, post jobs, hire freelancers
Freelancer mode: browse jobs, submit proposals, manage work
User role selection (customer or freelancer) during onboarding/signup

Fix the LoginPage redirect logic so that users who already have a role assigned in the backend are sent directly to their role-appropriate dashboard, bypassing the role selection page entirely. The role selection page should only be shown to users who have no role stored yet.
